observations: Two photos show the same stack of flat-plate solar panels (monocrystalline cell pattern, black hexagon-cut cells) leaning against a wall, viewed from similar angles.
Multiple panels appear stacked side by side, suggesting more than one unit in the shop.
A semi-transparent watermark reads 'DON KACHI SOLAR ENERGY' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' overlaid on the image - this is the seller's branding/platform watermark, not a manufacturer label on the product.
No visible manufacturer logo, model number, or wattage/spec sticker on the panel frame or glass.
No junction box, cabling, or back of panel shown.
Panels show some dust and frame wear consistent with either new stock sitting in storage or used/removed panels.
Floor is bare concrete, indoor storage/warehouse setting.

claims.evidence: No price, spec sheet, or comparison given in photos or text; this is a subjective sales phrase.

risks.risk: Unknown wattage/power rating, which is the primary price determinant for solar panels
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rear specification sticker showing model, wattage (Wp), voltage, and current ratings
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at any tier without this; wattage spans too wide a price range to assume worst case

risks.risk: Panel may be used/pulled rather than new, affecting output and lifespan
risks.proof: Clear photo of full panel back and frame corners, plus any visible date-of-manufacture or install marks

risks.risk: Actual power output unverified - cracks or delamination not visible from this angle/distance
risks.proof: Multimeter or solar panel tester reading under sunlight, shown in photo or video, plus close-up of full cell surface without glare

risks.risk: Ambiguous whether listing covers one panel or the whole stack shown
risks.proof: Seller confirmation in writing of quantity included at the stated price
risks.if_unproven: priced as a single unit only

proof_requests: Photo of the rear specification label showing brand, model, and wattage (Wp)
Video or photo of a multimeter test showing voltage/current output under sunlight
Clear photo of the full panel back and all four corners for crack/delamination check
Confirmation of exact quantity included in the offer
response.reason: Solar panel pricing depends heavily on wattage/model, and no specification label, logo, or rating is visible in either photo, so even a worst-case price cannot be set without that missing shot.
